passages.text: Our street club holds a friendly chess afternoon for neighbours. Mr Wu, a senior, offers to play the first game with me. My aunt is an adult who volunteers to keep the scores for the tables. I try to win quickly and move a piece without looking carefully. Mr Wu asks me to look at all the pieces before my next move. This time I wait, think and find a better place for my piece. I do not win, but I leave wanting to play another game.

parallelText.en: Our street club holds a friendly chess afternoon for neighbours.
parallelText.zh: 我们街道社团为邻居们举办了一次友好的国际象棋下午活动。

parallelText.en: Mr Wu, a senior, offers to play the first game with me.
parallelText.zh: 一位长者吴先生主动提出和我下第一盘棋。

parallelText.en: My aunt is an adult who volunteers to keep the scores for the tables.
parallelText.zh: 阿姨是一位成年人，她自愿为各桌记分。

parallelText.en: I try to win quickly and move a piece without looking carefully.
parallelText.zh: 我急着取胜，没有仔细看就移动了一枚棋子。

parallelText.en: Mr Wu asks me to look at all the pieces before my next move.
parallelText.zh: 吴先生让我在下一步前先观察全部棋子。

parallelText.en: This time I wait, think and find a better place for my piece.
parallelText.zh: 这一次我等一等、想一想，给棋子找了个更好的位置。

parallelText.en: I do not win, but I leave wanting to play another game.
parallelText.zh: 我没赢，但离开时还想再下一盘。

one of the objects moved in a board game
a record of points in a game

passages.text: A notice outside our park announces a new library. My friend worries that the town will remove our favourite garden to build it. We read the small map and find that the library site is across the street from the park. It is an empty yard, not the garden inside the park. The poster also shows a path from the park gate to the future library entrance. My friend smiles because we will keep the garden and gain a place to read. Before telling others, we check the map once more.

parallelText.en: A notice outside our park announces a new library.
parallelText.zh: 公园外的一则告示宣布将建一座新图书馆。

parallelText.en: My friend worries that the town will remove our favourite garden to build it.
parallelText.zh: 朋友担心镇上会拆掉我们最喜欢的花园来建图书馆。

parallelText.en: We read the small map and find that the library site is across the street from the park.
parallelText.zh: 我们看了小地图，发现图书馆的地点在公园的街对面。

parallelText.en: It is an empty yard, not the garden inside the park.
parallelText.zh: 那是一块空院子，不是公园里的花园。

parallelText.en: The poster also shows a path from the park gate to the future library entrance.
parallelText.zh: 海报还画出一条从公园大门通往未来图书馆入口的小路。

parallelText.en: My friend smiles because we will keep the garden and gain a place to read.
parallelText.zh: 朋友笑了，因为花园保留了，我们又多了一处读书的地方。

parallelText.en: Before telling others, we check the map once more.
parallelText.zh: 告诉别人前，我们再次核对了地图。

wordHelp.meaning: a written message for people to read
